failure_summary.description: Several trajectories used an incorrect tool identifier, omitted requested calls, or added calls that did not serve a requested outcome.
Arguments sometimes had incorrect values or casing, missed constraints, or were placed in the wrong required/optional bucket.
One response contained duplicate parameter keys and unsupported calls or filler values.

patch.reasoning: These failure modes are already directly addressed by the skill’s outcome audit, smallest-call-set rule, exact tool and schema requirements, parameter-bucket guidance, and JSON validation. Additional instructions would repeat existing guidance or encode brittle conventions; some expected calls also appear to rely on implicit defaults or redundant checks that conflict with the skill’s current rules.
